items.title: Rick Margitza interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 22, 2024
items.q: the drummer is one of my oldest friends from New Orleans named Jeff Boudreaux

ctx.x: All original material, yeah. So the nucleus, the quartet on that record is the quartet that I work with here in Paris, and actually the drummer is one of my oldest friends from New Orleans named Jeff Boudreaux, who was in Paris before I was, also the bass player named Peter Giron is from New York in the Bronx. So three ex-pats and a French pianist, and we had been working together for the last five, six, seven years. So going in there and having my band and the music that we had been playing made it relatively…

whole record took almost four years, even though the majority of it was recorded in four days. The finishing of it and the mixing and mastering and orchestrating and bringing people in to do the overdubbing and all that was done in stages.
